MITIGATION
Review of individual structures prior to demolition should be undertaken by the San Jose Historic Landmarks Commission. Special attention should be focused on the rehabilitation program for the historic Olinder (Carnegie) Library. During excavations for sewer lines and building foundations, qualified historic and prehistoric archaeologists should be on site to identify sensitive cultural resources.
Rehabilitation of older, substandard dwelling units should include efforts to reduce existing energy ineffeciencies. Any newly-constructed public facilities should be designed to ensure maximum energy conservation.
